Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations , from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients. Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin . Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified B Corp™ , we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day. We are looking for a highly motivated Junior Financial Controller to own the integrity of our numbers and help deeply understand and steer the business. You will be responsible for a fast, accurate month-end close, robust reporting and internal controls, and you will support budgeting, forecasting, and performance management. This role falls within the FP&A department and will partner closely with Accounting, our Operational Teams and our Leadership Team to track spend, improve visibility, and provide insights into business mechanics that drive efficient growth. This is an ideal role for someone with a solid accounting and controlling foundation who enjoys business partnering and wants to understand and discover the deeper mechanics of a D2C business and operations in a fast-growing environment. Your Tasks: Own the monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing process from a controlling perspective, including thorough review of accruals, provisions, and reconciliations Prepare monthly management reporting (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and reporting for different stakeholders, including leadership and investors Support budgeting vs. actuals, forecasting, and long-range planning for SG&A functions including Brand, HR, Product Development and Customer Care Track budget vs. actuals and forecast, and prepare variance analysis with clear explanations of underlying drivers Maintain and update models and drivers behind operating expenses Oversee inventory valuation, cost of goods sold, and product margin analysis across sales channels Monitor G&A spend and identify cost optimization opportunities Design, implement, and maintain internal controls, guidelines, and finance processes (e.g. approval flows, cost center structure, chart of accounts) Act as a finance partner to functional leaders, helping them understand spend trends and trade-offs Help setting up KPI & trend analysis to support data driven decision making Your Profile: Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a comparable field 2-3 years of experience in Controlling, Accounting or FP&A, ideally in e-commerce or D2C, consumer goods. Audit firm experience is a plus Solid knowledge of German GAAP (HGB), IFRS and month-end/year-end closing Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and hands-on mentality Process driven and excited about setting up new projects and flows from scratch Strong collaboration & communication skills Experience working at a growing scale-up or consulting with strong collaboration and communication Experience with G-Suite or Excel, ERP and FP&A systems. NetSuite is a plus Fluent in English What We Offer: Dynamic Environment : The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team. Accelerate Your Career : Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand. Inspiring Workspace : Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks. Hybrid Working : We understand

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Turn new revenue opportunities into products construction companies pay for. Your mission Cosuno is the marketplace where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, and subcontractors find and win new projects. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform. We see several ways to grow from here, such as new modules for existing customers or customer segments we don't serve yet. As our Senior PM for Growth, you'll own one of these opportunities and you'll help choose the next. Next to that, you'll take care of the day-to-day product work in your area. What you'll do Find the real problem. Talk to customers, many of whom aren't tech-savvy, dig into our data and work out who has the problem, how much it matters and what we need to build. Put AI to work. Construction still runs on a lot of manual work. You'll find where AI can replace it and turn that into products customers love. Test before you build. Prototype and run small experiments with real customers before Engineering commits, then ship with Design and Engineering. Bring it to market. Launch with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, from positioning and pricing to enablement, and measure what it brings in. After one year, you've taken your first opportunity to real customers, you're working on your second, and the new offerings bring in measurable revenue. How we work Full ownership. You own your growth opportunity end to end, from the first customer conversation to the revenue it brings in. Design and Engineering build with you. Close to the customer. You'll talk to customers constantly. Fast and data-driven. We ship every two weeks, test ideas before we build them and judge every launch by its numbers. AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day. For every opportunity, your first question is: where can AI take manual work off our customers' hands? What you bring 3–5 years as a product manager in B2B SaaS, and you want to stay hands-on You've taken a new revenue opportunity (a module, upsell, segment or market) from idea to a product customers pay for You've shipped AI features that customers actually use, and you use AI tools every day in your own work You work with numbers and experiments, and you change course when the data says so You explain complex things simply, to a site manager as well as to management German at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our engineering team in English Experience with two-sided marketplaces, or with construction or another industry that is just going digital. Why us? Real impact: You own a growth opportunity, with short decision paths to our Head of Product, and you see the result in our numbers. A head start: Your first opportunity is prepared for you, so you can get going from day one. Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average. Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Europe, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg. Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro. A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events. Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company. Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations. About us Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology. We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity. Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. jobs.title: Senior Partner Manager (German speaking)
jobs.description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Role We’re looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Senior Partner Manager (Strategic Partnerships) to build and scale Perk’s partner ecosystem across Europe, with a particular focus on the DACH region. This is a commercial role with a clear objective: build partnerships that generate qualified sales pipeline and revenue for Perk. You’ll identify and recruit the right partners, develop joint go-to-market strategies, and turn those relationships into a repeatable growth channel. You’ll work closely with Sales and Marketing while owning partner relationships from initial outreach through launch, activation, and ongoing performance. The ideal person combines a builder’s mindset with strong commercial instincts. You’re comfortable opening doors, creating something from scratch, and earning the trust of senior stakeholders. You’re ambitious, persistent, and focused on measurable results. What You’ll Do Build our partner ecosystem: Identify, recruit, and develop high-potential referral, reseller, technology, and strategic alliance partners across Europe, with a particular focus on DACH. Generate pipeline and revenue: Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline targets, turning partnerships into a meaningful and repeatable growth channel for Perk. Create joint go-to-market strategies: Build plans with priority partners across target accounts, campaigns, events, referrals, and co-selling motions. Own the commercial relationship: Lead partner conversations from initial outreach through business case development, negotiation, contracting, launch, and ongoing growth. Activate and enable partners: Give partners the product knowledge, sales materials, training, and support they need to confidently position Perk and identify opportunities. Partner closely with Sales and Marketing: Ensure partner-generated opportunities are effectively routed, prioritised, and converted, while creating scalable ways for our commercial teams to work with partners. Measure and improve performance: Set targets, forecast partner pipeline and revenue, identify what’s working, and continuously improve our partnership strategy and playbooks. Bring new opportunities to Perk: Stay close to market and product developments and identify new partner models that can accelerate growth or create meaningful value for our customers. What We’re Looking For Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German and professional fluency in English. Track record: Proven success in partnerships, alliances, channel sales, or business development, ideally within SaaS, fintech, travel technology, or another B2B technology

Sie nutzen Recruitingkennzahlen, um die Wirksamkeit der Maßnahmen zu beurteilen und Verbesserungen anzustoßen. Sie bringen Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung der Recruitingprozesse und der Arbeitgeberpräsentation ein. Das bringen Sie mit Erfahrung im Recruiting, beispielsweise in einem Unternehmen oder in der Personalberatung. Praxis in der Direktansprache und ein gutes Gespür für passende Suchwege. Freude an enger Zusammenarbeit und daran, Wissen und Erfahrungen im Team zu teilen. Erfahrung mit kaufmännischen Positionen ist hilfreich; Kenntnisse im Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld sind willkommen. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.&nbsp;</strong><br><strong>&nbsp;</strong><br><strong>For more information, visit <a href="https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwpp.com%2F&amp;data=05%7C02%7CErica.Durr%40wpp.com%7C9bf4566a65bc46a48ac008de749116ea%7C150b5e663d884dee83f6ed149b727a00%7C0%7C0%7C639076363668176216%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=Q9juosud56XGLThSFZ1NpPZd6FXpJPxV74OeRZWoh%2B4%3D&amp;reserved=0" target="_blank">WPP.com.</a></strong><br><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Why we're hiring:</strong></span></p> <p>As a Data Steward in the WPP’s Enterprise Technology Data team, you will be responsible for the hands-on administration and maintenance of master data across one or more enterprise data domains. Reporting to the Global Programme Director - Data, you will be the first line of stewardship, ensuring that golden records are accurate, source system mappings are maintained, and data governance standards are consistently applied.</p> <p>You will execute matching and mapping activities, triage stewardship exceptions, and support the onboarding of new source systems into the MDM framework. Your work will directly impact the trustworthiness and completeness of master data flowing through WPP’s enterprise platforms.</p> <p>This role involves daily data administration including investigating and resolving match conflicts, maintaining entity mappings and hierarchies, classifying data assets, and supporting the operational processes that keep master data healthy across the enterprise.</p> <p>You will be part of a Data Steward team led by the Global Programme Director - Data, with the opportunity to develop deep expertise in master data management, data governance, and stewardship at enterprise scale.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What you'll be doing:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Master data stewardship and golden record maintenance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Execute day-to-day stewardship activities including reviewing, approving, and correcting master data records in line with governance standards set by the Global Programme Director - Data.</li> <li>Maintain and curate golden records, ensuring survivorship rules are correctly applied and master entities remain accurate and complete.</li> <li>Investigate and resolve match conflicts, potential duplicates, and merge exceptions, escalating complex cases to the Global Programme Dir

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
jobs.description: <h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.</p> <p>Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.</p> <p>You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.</p> <p>The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.</p> <p>In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.</p> <p>This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Your responsibilities will include:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Own the vertical roadmap. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
jobs.description: <h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.</p> <p>We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.</p> <p>When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.</p> <p>The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.</p> <p>The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.</p> <p>In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.</p> <p>This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Your responsibilities will include:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.</li> <li>Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.</li> <li>Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.</li> <li>Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.</li> <li>Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.</li> <li>Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.</li> <li>Partner with the data and vertical product owners on what our corpus needs to contain and how results should be shaped per industry.</li> </ul> <p><strong&gt

jobs.description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As the Director of EMEA Field Enablement, you hold a high-impact role at the intersection of strategy and field execution. Rubrik is growing quickly, and the field needs a leader who can connect global corporate strategy with the realities of selling across EMEA’s different markets, buying cultures and levels of maturity.</p> <p>You will own the readiness and productivity of the EMEA sales organization. You’ll architect and scale enablement programs, from onboarding for new hires through to advanced value selling for tenured sellers. The goal is that every Account Executive can clearly communicate Rubrik’s Zero Trust Data Security and AI-driven resilience story to the organizations, from hospitals to governments to financial institutions, that rely on us to keep operating.</p> <p>You’ll work directly with the GVP of EMEA and regional sales leaders, with the backing of Global Enablement and the autonomy to decide what your theater needs. jobs.title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
jobs.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you! Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will: Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning : Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets. The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership : Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope. Localization & Regional Adaptation : Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision. Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement : Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent. Improve our on-call rotation for the team, defining the alerting, escalation paths, and response SLAs that make it work. Automate detection and response workflows, using code and AI to reduce manual toil and shorten time to resolution. Reduce SecOps-attributed risk identified through compliance gaps, and collect the evidence that demonstrates it. Build dashboards and reporting that give the team and leadership real visibility into response times, coverage, and risk reduction. Work cross-functionally with engineers who don't have a security background, translating threat models into changes they can actually ship. What you bring You'll thrive in this role if you have: 10+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or a closely related discipline, with a proven track record of materialised risk reduction through monetary impact, incidents contained, forensics that changed outcomes. A strong development and engineering background. You are comfortable writing the automation, not just specifying it. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: You’ll be a Technical Leader, unblock the engineering team by resolving complex technical impasses, standardising engineering practices, and owning cross-functional initiatives. You'll still be a highly hands-on engineer, responsible for rapidly prototyping, shipping MVPs, and turning product ideas into polished user experiences. You’ll work across the stack, collaborating closely with product, design, and engineering teams while operating with a high degree of independence. What you'll do Build and ship new product features end-to-end Lead rapid prototyping and MVP development Develop modern frontend applications using TypeScript, Vue 3 Composition API, and Tailwind Contribute to backend services using Node, Bun, Koa, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and AWS Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to shape product direction Improve performance, reliability, and developer experience across the platfor Support on hiring, performance and technical roadmaps. What you'll need Extensive experience building modern frontend applications with TypeScript and Vue3 Solid backend experience with Node-based services and relational databases Experience working with PostgreSQL, Prisma, AWS, and REST APIs Comfortable moving quickly, making pragmatic decisions, and shipping iteratively Strong communication and collaboration skills Able to work independently in a hybrid environment Ideally have been in early stage start-ups going through growth and technical challenges What you'll get Time off that works for you: Unlimited holiday policy, including a guaranteed 33 days plus your birthday off Flexible hybrid working: Work in a way that helps you do your best work, while staying connected with the team. A stake in what we’re building: Eligible employees can participate in our EMI share option scheme. Healthcare that goes further: After one year’s service, access private healthcare through Vitality, including dental, optical, hearing and therapy cover. More ways to get around: Access our company car salary-sacrifice scheme. Support for growing families: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave. About Cytix Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words. We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you. Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still. Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale. See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it. Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics. Play to win. jobs.title: Senior Partner Manager (German speaking)
jobs.description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . jobs.description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it We are growing our product design team and looking for an experienced mobile designer to expand features on our Android and iOS apps. You will have the opportunity to make financial services more accessible and inclusive for millions of people through working with thoughtful product managers, researchers, and engineers! In this role, you'll: Work closely with product managers, user researchers, engineers, and data analysts from the start to end of a feature. Create high quality designs, interactions, and prototypes to explore ideas in service of the best solution for the project (Wave uses Figma). Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, we are offering a salary of up to $187,000 USD based on your location (paid in your local currency equivalent), plus a generous equity package. Major benefits: Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country) 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance Unlimited vacation with a 20-day minimum requirement, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays $10,000 annual charitable donation matching Requirements Experience with low and high-fidelity design & prototyping with LLMs on Android mobile apps Fluency in English. jobs.title: AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. We are looking for a Data & AI / ML Evaluation Engineer to own the data collection, mining, curation and continuous evaluation foundation for our various AI security products. High-quality models require high-quality datasets and ongoing enrichment and retraining. In this role, you will build automated data ingestion pipelines from surrogate web traffic and open sources, manage dataset curation, labeling workflows, model training and operate our benchmark and evaluation harnesses. This is a data and AI / ML software engineering role focused on building the data infrastructure that trains our proprietary Prompt Injection SLMs, Shadow-AI detection models, Malicious Macro classifiers, PII, Content Classification engines and more. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: Automated, continuous generation and curation of training, evaluation, and false-positive (FP) datasets across web, file, and macro threat surfaces. Standardized, reproducible evaluation benchmarks that guide model improvements before deployment. Automated data pipeline uptime and ingestion throughput from web/file sources. Size, diversity, and labeling accuracy of threat dataset repositories (PI, Shadow-AI, PII, Macros). Mean time to ingest live false-positive/false-negative feedback into training evaluation loops. Accuracy and benchmark coverage across historical vs. newly trained SLMs. What You'll Do Design and operate automated data collection, mining, and web-scraping pipelines to gather threat samples from surrogate traffic and web sources. Build data processing, annotation, and dataset curation workflows, training and re-training various models, e.g. Prompt Injection (PI) SLMs, Shadow-AI detection models, Malicious Macro classifiers, and PII detection. Build mechanisms to capture false-positive (FP) samples from live user/DDR flows and represent / integrate them into model retraining pipelines. Develop automated benchmarking and evaluation harnesses to continuously test model detection quality, runtime performance, and accuracy against baseline models (e.g., Vertex AI). Build automated pipelines for model training for various models. Work closely with research and software engineering teams to turn raw detection telemetry into ongoing actionable model improvements. Required: 2–4 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or automated QA/evaluation roles. Strong programming proficiency in Python. Adv: C++, SQL. Experience in model training and various ML, AI algorithms. Experience building data pipelines, web scrapers, or automated data processing systems. jobs.title: Médecin Généraliste - Alan Précision 🩸
jobs.description: 🐻 Qui est Alan ? En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé . La Clinique Alan réunit plus de 120 professionnels de santé disponibles 7j/7 : médecins généralistes, sages-femmes, psychologues, kinésithérapeutes, dermatologues, pédiatres, nutritionnistes, infirmières puéricultrices. Nos membres bénéficient d'une prise en charge véritablement intégrée : 🩺 Téléconsultation vidéo : pour les situations qui nécessitent une consultation médicale en direct 💬 Chat médical : conseils de professionnels de santé, 7j/7, réponse en moins de 30 minutes 🤖 Mo, notre compagnon santé IA : répond instantanément aux questions du quotidien, avec des réponses relues et validées par nos médecins 🎯 Des programmes de prévention (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés 🧘 Alan Play : une approche ludique de la prévention autour de l'activité physique, du bien-être mental et de la cohésion d'équipe 🩸 Qu’est-ce qu’Alan Précision ? Il s’agit de notre tout nouveau programme de prévention ; un service de santé préventive avancée, à la croisée de la médecine de précision, de la biologie et du mode de vie. Le constat : en France, il y a environ 12 ans d’écart entre l’espérance de vie et l’espérance de vie en bonne santé, et plus de la moitié des maladies chroniques sont évitables. Plutôt que d’attendre les symptômes, nous repérons les signaux biologiques précoces et nous les traduisons en actions concrètes . Le service repose sur trois briques : 💉 Un bilan sanguin de plus de 80 biomarqueurs et ratios , réalisé dans plus de 300 laboratoires partenaires. Il couvre le cardiovasculaire (ApoB, Lp(a)…), le métabolisme (insuline, HOMA-IR, HbA1c), le foie, le rein, la thyroïde, l’inflammation (hs-CRP), les micronutriments et les hormones. 💬 Un questionnaire d’environ 200 questions sur le mode de vie, les objectifs et les antécédents. 🎯 Un rapport personnalisé généré par IA et validé par nos médecins , qui contient l’analyse de chaque biomarqueur en contexte, un Score de Santé, un Âge Biologique, des recommandations sur le mode de vie et un plan d’action avec 3-5 objectifs prioritaires basés sur les grands “piliers” de la prévention (activité physique, nutrition, santé mentale, sommeil, …). 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Nous recrutons des médecins généralistes curieux de prévention et de médecine de précision , pour rejoindre le petit groupe de médecins qui relisent et valident les rapports Alan Précision. ✅ Curieux(se) de ce que l’IA peut apporter à la pratique ✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients ✅ Un vrai intérêt pour la thématique et l'envie d'apprendre : un DU (nutrition, prévention…) est un plus, mais pas indispensable ✅ Disponible au moins 4h par semaine (horaires flexibles) ✅ Statut libéral 🧠 Votre rôle : le regard médical qui fait la différence L’IA prépare, vous validez. Avant d’arriver chez le membre, chaque rapport passe entre vos mains : vous en êtes le garant médical, et c’est votre expertise qui en fait un rapport fiable et utile. Concrètement, vous : Relisez le rapport généré par l’IA et vérifier son exactitude médicale Vous vous assurez que les interprétations collent au profil de la personne (âge, sexe, activité, habitudes) Apportez la nuance que seul un médecin sait apporter : un lien de causalité trop affirmatif (« est causé par » doit devenir « peut être lié à ») une formulation anxiogène une incohérence entre les sections du rapport une recommandation qui ne correspond pas au profil une supplémentation exotique ou mal étayée Êtes le filet de sécurité : vous bloquez et faites remonter les situations qui sortent du cadre de la prévention (valeur critique, pathologie active suspectée, interaction médicamenteuse…) Signalez les erreurs récurrentes de l’IA : vos corrections servent directement à amél

jobs.title: Stage Master 2 : Elaboration de panneaux biosourcés à base de pailles
jobs.description: L'IMT Mines Alès, grande école de prestige qui se classe parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs sur le plan national et mondial et implantée à Alès, ville à taille humaine, capitale des Cévennes où la qualité de vie est fortement appréciée par ses habitants. Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr Contexte : Le stage à pourvoir s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet européen Best-Crop impliquant 18 partenaires à l’échelle européenne : https://www.bestcrop.eu/ dont le but est de contribuer à développer l’économie circulaire en offrant de nouvelles variétés d’orge à rendement amélioré ( article de perspective – projet Best-Crop ). ). L’un des volets du projet consiste à fournir des pailles d’orge de composition et/ou structure optimisées pour différentes applications, dont, entre autres, le secteur de la construction (fabrication de panneaux de particules et de biocomposites). Dans le cadre de ce projet, l’équipe PCH a pour tâche d’étudier l’influence de la sélection et du fractionnement des pailles issues de différentes variétés d’orge, ainsi que d’étudier la microstructure et le comportement mécanique de panneaux biosourcés élaborés par pressage à chaud. Objectifs : Le stage consiste à mettre en œuvre des panneaux de pailles, d’optimiser le procédé de fabrication, et d’évaluer la variabilité des comportements mécaniques et d’isolation observés en regard de la composition et de la morphologie des pailles pour développer des panneaux performants. Le travail contribuera également à compléter la large base de données sur les panneaux à renforts lignocellulosiques développés au laboratoire. jobs.title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques - CDD de 18 mois
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises. La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement. Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques pour rejoindre le département INFRES à Télécom Paris. Le poste est accueilli au sein de Quriosity, équipe commune à Inria et Télécom Paris, au laboratoire LTCI et au département Informatique et Réseaux (INFRES). Située à Palaiseau, sur le plateau de Saclay, l’équipe bénéficie d’un environnement actif en information quantique et en fondements de la théorie quantique. Le recrutement relève du projet PIQ « Nouveaux outils algébriques pour les décompositions causales des processus quantiques », sous la responsabilité d’Augustin Vanrietvelde. Il porte sur la phase 1 du projet, pour une durée de 18 mois. Le projet étudie la conjecture des décompositions causales : tout canal unitaire admettrait une décomposition dont les connexions reflètent fidèlement sa structure causale. L’objectif est de développer des outils algébriques et syntaxiques pour étudier des cas ouverts, construire des décompositions ou identifier des obstructions. La recherche est exploratoire ; les résultats partiels et les limites des méthodes seront documentés. Vos principales missions seront de : Mener des recherches sur les décompositions causales des processus quantiques dans le cadre de la phase 1 du projet PIQ. Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat de projets étudiants et de stages. Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique de Télécom Paris, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en physique, mathématiques, informatique ou dans une discipline pertinente pour le projet, obtenu au plus tard à la prise de fonctions. Vous devez posséder de solides connaissances en fondements quantiques, notamment en causalité quantique, ou en méthodes algébriques avancées, ainsi que de bonnes capacités de raisonnement mathématique, de démonstration et d’analyse critique. Vous devez être autonome dans la conduite de recherches théoriques, savoir rédiger des travaux scientifiques rigoureux et maîtriser l’anglais scientifique, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Des connaissances en algèbres d’opérateurs, en information quantique et en formalismes diagrammatiques sont souhaitées. Une expérience en calcul symbolique ou numérique appliqué à des problèmes théoriques, ainsi qu’en encadrement d’étudiants, constitue un atout. Enfin, vous devez faire preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de capacités de dialogue et de synthèse, ainsi que de solides qualités rédactionnelles et pédagogiques. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). Vous bénéficierez de : 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT) flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service) télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75% Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne... jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship. Role overview UX is our number one priority. As a Series B scale-up, we are investing heavily in the product experience, and you will be central to it. You will own our biggest new product bets: new features, health insights and early vision work across the app. You will bring ideas to life fast, with polished high-fidelity prototypes and motion, then take them to a shipped result. You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. Alongside you are a Lead Product Designer and a Lead UX Writer, who keep the whole product consistent and high quality. You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft. Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe. Core responsibilities Ownership & Outcomes Own your product areas from first idea to shipped result. Set the measures for your work and own whether it succeeds. Turn research, feedback and data into clear decisions. Prototyping & Design Spin up working prototypes with AI tools and our design system, not just static screens. Collaboration & Continuity Work daily with design engineers and product managers, and unblock them fast. Take over existing product design work and keep quality high. jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description: Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it. quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end. We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll. We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all. Why this role exists Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries. The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now. This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it. What you will own Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket. The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent. The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current. Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms. The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns. The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team. Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built. How we work We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here. We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard. Your first year In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival. By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team. Who we are looking for You have shipped and run product

jobs.description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked. We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world Example Projects Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately Exa is an equal opportunity employer. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on. What you'll do Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down. Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan. Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out. Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions. Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found. Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it? AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals. We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role. Why a designer now We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market. That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind. You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. jobs.title: Medior / Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description: SQL in BigQuery? Gesneden koek. Een dashboard in Looker Studio? Staat er zo. Maar jij wil meer. Je wil weten welk verhaal er achter de cijfers zit, en je vertelt dat verhaal net zo graag. Met een advies waar klanten en collega’s echt iets mee kunnen. AI zet je daarbij vanzelfsprekend in, om sneller en slimmer tot de kern te komen. Wij zijn Follo: een snelgroeiend, award-winning digital agency (ontstaan uit de fusie van vier topbureaus) waar data de basis is onder alles wat we doen. Als Medior Data Analist werk je zelfstandig voor een eigen set klanten en projecten, samen met onze Data & Analytics Consultants en de specialisten in Search en Social. Je levert niet alleen de cijfers, je vertelt ook wat ze betekenen en wat er moet gebeuren. Wat je gaat doen Je analyseert data uit onder andere GA4, advertentieplatformen en CRM- en e-commercesystemen en ontdekt zo trends, kansen en knelpunten. Je zet AI actief in om sneller patronen te herkennen, hypotheses te toetsen, SQL te schrijven en grote datasets te doorgronden, zonder je kritische blik op de uitkomsten te verliezen. Je presenteert je bevindingen aan klanten en collega’s en vertaalt ze naar heldere, commerciële aanbevelingen. Je komt zelf met verbetervoorstellen voor marketing, meetopzet en businessprocessen, en kijkt verder dan de vraag. Je schrijft SQL in BigQuery en bouwt aan schone, herbruikbare datamodellen (bijvoorbeeld in Dataform), zodat databronnen goed gekoppeld zijn en iedereen met dezelfde definities werkt. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt overzichtelijke dashboards en rapportages in onder andere Looker Studio, en bepaalt mee welke KPI’s er echt toe doen en hoe je die het best visualiseert. Je bewaakt de betrouwbaarheid van data, signaleert afwijkingen en spoort de oorzaak op, of die nu in de tracking, de koppeling of het model zit. Je maakt terugkerend werk slimmer met automatisering en AI, en deelt je kennis met het team. Wat je van ons mag verwachten Een salaris tussen de €3.250 en €5.000, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Een ambitieus team waarin verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerken voorop staan. 26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen. Een eenmalig thuiswerkbudget tot €1.000 om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. Een goed geregeld pensioen, zonder eigen bijdrage. De vrijheid om hybride te werken, zodat jij het best tot je recht komt. Interne kennissessies, events en brainstorms, van AI en automatisering tot data deep-dives. Dit ben jij Je bent een analist met oog voor detail die het grotere plaatje blijft zien. Je werkt gestructureerd, bent nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe data begrijpelijk te maken voor anderen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als data analist of in een vergelijkbare rol. Je bent communicatief sterk: je legt een analyse net zo makkelijk uit aan een marketing manager als aan een developer, en je durft met een onderbouwd advies te komen. Je beheerst SQL goed; ervaring met BigQuery is een grote pré. Je hebt ruime ervaring met dashboarding in Looker Studio, Power BI of een vergelijkbare tool. Je kent GA4 en begrijpt hoe online marketingdata tot stand komt. Ervaring met Google Tag Manager is een pré. Je gebruikt AI al in je dagelijkse analysewerk, of hebt de sterke ambitie om dat te doen. Kennis van Python of ervaring met Dataform of dbt is mooi meegenomen. Waarom Follo? Bij Follo is data geen bijproduct van marketing, maar het fundament eronder. Van Search en Social tot Marketplaces en CRO: elke strategie begint bij betrouwbare data en scherpe inzichten. AI is bij ons geen buzzword, maar onderdeel van hoe we dagelijks werken. Minder handwerk, meer tijd voor analyse, advies en impact. Data als fundament: met de FolloEngine, ons eigen platform voor data intelligence, datakwaliteit en automatisering, start je met een voorsprong. AI in je dagelijkse werk: je werkt met de nieuwste tools en technieken, van AI-gedreven analyse tot geautomatiseerde workflows. Ste

In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer  maakt. Hier zit je op je plek Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen, met de focus op nieuwbouwprojecten. Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige waardestromen, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams: de waardestromen. Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken! A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events. What do you bring to the table? A completed Bachelor’s and Master’s degree with a numerical component.

jobs.description: At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Our paid marketing campaigns run on predictions about which new users will turn out to be valuable. This role makes sure those predictions are right. That’s where you come in. As our  Data Scientist, Marketing , you’ll own the machine learning models that predict the value of every newly verified user and feed that value into Google Ads, so our campaigns find more users like them. If the models are off, the spend is off. AI can help you write and debug code, but it can’t build the model or judge whether the output can be trusted. That judgment is yours. Take Ownership 🚀 You’ll own the predictive models that steer our marketing spend. Here’s how you’ll do it: Build, maintain and expand the predictive models for marketing, from first idea to production, starting with the models that predict each new user’s value in their first 90 days. Hit the model quality targets within 9 months: a Spearman rank correlation of 0.50 or higher and a binary model AUC of 0.75 or higher. Keep the models running in production and monitor data and model health to find where to intervene, using Claude Code to move faster and validating everything it produces. You’ve built predictive models with traditional machine learning, such as XGBoost. You’ve written Python and built the data pipelines a model needs, including when none existed. You’ve shipped ML models to production and kept them running. You’ve done deep dives into data and model health to find what needs intervention. jobs.title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
jobs.description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten; Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties; Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen; Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen; Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties; Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd; Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service. Was uns fehlt, ist jemand, der daraus saubere, stabile Software macht und dabei mitdenkt, wohin die Reise geht. Deine Quests – LeaseFox weiterbauen: neue Features, Bugs jagen, Architektur aufräumen. – Mit KI entwickeln: Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot sind für dich Werkzeuge und keine Spielerei. Du weißt, wann du der KI trauen kannst und wann nicht. – Automatisieren: Muss etwas zum dritten Mal von Hand erledigt werden, schreibst du ein Skript dafür. – Prototypen bauen: Du testest neue Ideen schnell und zeigst, was technisch geht. – Ordnung ins kreative Chaos bringen: Du machst aus schnellen Ideen wartbaren Code, mit Struktur, Tests und Doku. – Mitdenken: Du bringst eigene Ideen mit, statt nur Aufgaben abzuarbeiten. – Auch Grinding gehört dazu: Support-Anfragen unserer LeaseFox-Nutzer, Bugfixes, Pflege. Ohne das kein Level-up. Dein Skilltree – erste echte Projekte in Python, JavaScript oder TypeScript – Grundverständnis davon, wie Anwendungen, Datenbanken und APIs zusammenspielen – KI-Tools, mit denen du selbst schon etwas gebaut hast – logisches Denken und Durchhaltevermögen, wenn etwas nicht läuft – eigenständiges und zuverlässiges Arbeiten, auch wenn dir niemand über die Schulter schaut Ohne Marketing-Filter Einen Senior Developer, der dich an die Hand nimmt, gibt es bei uns nicht. Ein Tutorial-Level auch nicht, das hier ist Open World. Du musst nicht alles wissen. Du solltest aber herausfinden können, wie du eine Aufgabe löst, und merken, wann du Hilfe brauchst. Dein Loot – fast komplett remote, von überall in Deutschland – einmal im Monat 2–3 Tage gemeinsam in Sinsheim, quasi der Raid vor Ort – direkter Draht zum Unternehmer statt Hierarchie-Dungeon – echte Softwareprojekte mit viel Spielraum – moderne KI-Tools und die Freiheit, Neues auszuprobieren – viel Verantwortung und eine langfristige Perspektive in der Unternehmensgruppe Roadmap Nach ein paar Monaten kennst du unsere Anwendungen, hast eigene Lösungen live gebracht und setzt kleinere Projekte allein um. Langfristig wirst du unser technischer Mitdenker, der Ideen aufgreift und daraus funktionierende Software macht. Du musst heute nicht alles können. Du solltest aber Lust haben, morgen mehr zu können als heute. Bewerbung: kein Anschreiben, nur drei Fragen 1. Was hast du schon selbst gebaut, gern mit Link? 2. Welche Tools nutzt du am liebsten und warum? 3. Welches technische Problem hast du zuletzt allein geknackt? Optional: Was ist dein Lieblingsspiel und was sagt es über deine Arbeitsweise? GitHub, Repos, kleine Apps, halbfertige Experimente: Zeig uns ruhig alles. Wir mögen Leute, die Dinge ausprobieren, lieber als Leute, die nur darüber reden. Find Jobs in Germ

As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities. That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it. Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements. Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions. A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience. Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change. Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. jobs.title: Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT As the Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer, you will own the development of high-speed control and protection systems for the Alpha fusion demonstrator, focusing on FPGA-based solutions for plasma heating hardware protection. You will work across the full development lifecycle, from writing and verifying HDL code to developing software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, integrating embedded software and electronics, and establishing robust development and deployment pipelines. You will also help establish Proxima’s FPGA development capability beyond plasma heating, defining reusable architectures, development workflows, testing methodologies, and HDL best practices that can be adopted across other systems. WHAT YOU WILL DO Design, implement, and maintain HDL-based control and protection systems, starting with plasma heating system protection. Establish end-to-end FPGA development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and SIL/HIL test environments integrated with plant design frameworks. Develop embedded software, firmware, and low-level drivers to interface FPGAs with sensors, actuators, and other control systems. Collaborate across RF, controls, electronics, and systems teams to define system interfaces, ICDs, and verification plans. WHO YOU ARE Degree in Electronics, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience. Strong proficiency in HDL (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog) and software scripting (Python, C/C++). Proven experience integrating FPGAs with hardware peripherals, board-level electronics, and communication interfaces. Building the internal communications machine - you will design and own how leadership and our teams stay connected day to day - whether live or written, scheduled or ad hoc, and whatever formats a genuinely global, always-on business needs. You will build the architecture - cadence, ownership, structure - so the right message reaches the right people at the right moment, and noise becomes context rather than clutter. 2.
