This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative. jobs.description: What is Contentstack ? Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system. While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time. Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program. Learn more at www.contentstack.com . Who Are We? At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let’s go! What Are We Looking For? We’re looking for a Business Intelligence Data Architect to shape the analytical architecture, data modeling standards, and engineering practices that power enterprise reporting, governed metrics, and AI-enabled analytics at Contentstack. In this high-impact role, you’ll establish scalable, reusable modeling frameworks across Snowflake and dbt, lead the implementation of governed semantic models, and partner with Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, Revenue Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to build a trusted foundation for data-driven decision-making. If you’re passionate about modern analytics architecture, translating complex business needs into scalable solutions, and enabling the next generation of AI-powered analytics, we’d love to hear from you! Here's what you'll be doing: Lead analytical architecture and governance: Define enterprise modeling standards across staging, intermediate, dimensional, fact, semantic, and mart layers. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you. jobs.title: Contract Sr Data Analyst (SQL,Telemetry,Browser Engine)
jobs.description: The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets. Engineering Deliverables Automated Dashboards: Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership. Telemetry Gap Analysis: Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the product experience. Data Sanitization Frameworks: Develop methodologies and tools to identify and filter data inconsistencies, specifically focusing on isolating bot traffic and hardware-specific noise from telemetry streams. Behavioral Inference Reports: Deliver deep-dive analyses correlating technical performance shifts (e.g., LCP, eTLD+1) with user-facing pain points and engagement trends. Scope, Skills, and Effort Estimate Scope The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership. Required Skills Technical: Advanced SQL (BigQuery/Redash), proficiency in data visualization using AI tooling, and experience with statistical analysis (e.g., Pearson’s correlation, multivariate analysis). Knowledge of Rust/C++ is a strong plus. Strong proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar is highly desirable. Domain Knowledge: Ability to understand browser component interactions and their impact on user experience. Soft Skills: Proven ability to work independently, translating technical requirements into business insights. Independent problem solving: Comfortable working in unfamiliar technical problem spaces and figuring out a path forward with minimal guidance, using documentation, experimentation, source code, data, and other available resources. Hiring Ranges: Remote Germany $62,100—$82,800 USD

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
jobs.description: Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies. This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems. jobs.description: Overview of Position Are you energized by bringing structure to complex client work, turning data into practical recommendations, and making sure important commitments reach the finish line? Join Assurant as an Account Manager supporting lender-placed insurance clients. You’ll partner closely with experienced Account Executives and teams across Operations, Business Relationship Management, projects, claims, underwriting, customer care, and other areas to keep client priorities visible, organized, and moving forward. Apply today and help shape a better client experience across Assurant ’s Lending Solutions business! What makes us different? 100% work-from-home opportunity for U.S.-based employees. jobs.description: ABOUT ZERO TO THREE Founded in 1977, ZERO TO THREE works to ensure that babies and toddlers benefit from the early connections that are critical to their well-being and development. Working closely with and supervised by the Senior Professional Development Manager, IECMH, this position supports the implementation, delivery, and continuous improvement of the organization’s professional development portfolio focused on infant and early childhood mental health. The position has primary responsibility for coordinating the DC:0-5™ professional development portfolio, including professional learning, Trainer Certification, faculty consultant support, and implementation resources. The position collaborates across the organization and travels nationally to deliver professional development and represent ZERO TO THREE at meetings, conferences, and other professional events. ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES Support implementation and ongoing maintenance of the DC:0-5™ professional development portfolio in alignment with established strategic plans, including professional learning products, Trainer Certification, and implementation resources. Coordinate day-to-day implementation activities related to DC:0-5™ professional learning offerings, working closely with the Senior Professional Development Manager to ensure timely, high-quality execution. Lead, co-lead, and support delivery of research-based and evidence-informed DC:0-5™ and other IECMH professional learning offerings across multiple learning modalities. Provide day-to-day coordination and operational support for the DC:0-5™ Trainer Certification system, including communications, participant support, logistics, implementation resources, and record maintenance. Coordinate and support DC:0-5™ and other IECMH faculty consultants, including onboarding, communications, scheduling, resource development, and ongoing engagement. Maintain and update professional learning materials, trainer resources, implementation tools, and supporting documentation to ensure alignment with current content and organizational standards. Stay current with emerging research and promising practices related to infant and early childhood mental health, adult learning, workforce development, and implementation to support professional learning delivery and continuous quality improvement. Contribute to continuous quality improvement through the collection, analysis, and synthesis of participant, trainer, and implementation data, providing recommendations to strengthen professional learning products and services. Collaborate with colleagues across CMP and the broader organization to support coordinated planning, communication, implementation, and delivery of professional learning initiatives. Travel nationally, as required, to deliver professional development and represent ZERO TO THREE at meetings, conferences, and other professional events. Performs other duties as assigned to ensure the efficient and effective functioning of Professional Innovations. ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE Minimum of five (5) years of progressively responsible professional experience in infant and early childhood mental health, including direct clinical experience. Current DC:0-5™ Certified Trainer credential preferred. Candidates who are certification-ready and able to successfully complete the DC:0-5™ Trainer Certification process within six (6) months

In Vaccines, you’ll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization. Engage and coordinate across the full spectrum of multi-layered federal decision-making structures, ensuring Sanofi maintains sustained influence at every level of the government health hierarchy. jobs.description: AWS AI/IoT Architect Redapt Inc. is a pioneering world-class data center infrastructure integrator, technology engineering firm, and cloud services provider. Our teams focus on delivering innovative solutions and services that power our customers' most demanding applications and enable them to extract powerful insights from data that drive true business value. We are looking for a Senior AWS IoT Architect to join our Cloud Solutions team. This hands-on role will build and operate secure, multi-tenant IoT platforms on AWS, connecting embedded Linux devices and edge AI hardware to cloud services, and building and deploying generative AI solutions on AWS using Amazon Bedrock. Our engineers own implementation from device provisioning and on-device software through cloud integration, over-the-air updates, and fleet operations. You will work with cloud, embedded, and hardware teams to deliver reliable solutions and validate them on simulated fleets and physical development boards. Responsibilities Design and implement AWS IoT Core solutions for device onboarding, connectivity, identity, fleet management, and tenant isolation, using per-device X.509 certificates, mutual TLS, fleet provisioning with claim certificates, certificate revocation, and AWS Private CA. Develop AWS IoT Greengrass v2 components, recipes, and deployments for both the Java nucleus and nucleus lite, including on resource-constrained devices, with recovery and state-management behavior suited to the device. Design, develop, test, and deploy AI applications using Amazon Bedrock foundation models and AWS services, including model invocation, inference settings, and integration through AWS SDKs. Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions using Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases or custom retrieval pipelines, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector stores and vector search, retrieval quality, grounding in enterprise data, and source citations. Implement AI agents and tool integrations that connect models to enterprise APIs and workflows, with schema validation, controlled execution, error handling, explicit permissions, and human approval where needed. Develop prompts and structured extraction workflows for document understanding, classification, summarization, and business process automation. Build Python services and APIs that integrate AI capabilities with customer applications, databases, and enterprise data sources. Create representative evaluation datasets and automated tests to measure accuracy, grounding, extraction quality, and agent task completion; validate changes before release. Implement layered AI safeguards using Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, IAM, encryption, data access controls, output validation, and protections against prompt injection. Build on-device agents in Python and C/C++ for embedded Linux, build board images with Yocto, integrate systemd services, and cross-compile and package software for Arm and other embedded targets. Implement secure OTA pipelines for applications, models, and supported firmware, with manifests signed using AWS KMS or AWS Signer, verification before installation, staged rollout, health checks, failure recovery, rollback, and anti-rollback controls. Manage static and dynamic thing groups and AWS IoT Jobs, including rollout rates, abort thresholds, retries, and fleet deployment status. Build MQTT telemetry pipelines, topic structures, versioned message schemas, and IoT rules that route data to streaming services and Amazon S3, including buffering, reconnect behavior, and duplicate-message handling. Test at fleet scale with containerized device simulators and real-board lab testing, covering load, connectivity, provisioning, OTA, and recovery; diagnose connectivity, interrupted updates, power-loss recovery, security, and device performance issues. Apply device security practices, including secure boot, debug-port lockdown, least-privilege IoT policies, and hardware-backed keys where the device supports them.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (100% Remote)
jobs.description: In most companies a developer gets a ticket, builds it and moves on to the next one. Someone else talked to the customer, someone else decided what gets built, and whether it actually helped is someone else's question. We're looking for developers who want to do the whole job: talk to the people who use the software, decide what to build, build it and stay on it until it works for them. That's what we mean by product engineer. We took the term from PostHog, who describe it well in their Product Engineer Handbook. About us is software for property management companies in Germany. Inbox, CRM, documents, telephony, video calls, team chat and AI agents in one platform, so property managers can do their daily work in one place. We're a small team based in Worms, Germany, working fully remote. We're self-funded and profitable. What a product engineer does here You talk to customers. You read the support requests and feedback for your area, look at how customers use it and talk to them directly. Nobody filters it for you. You decide what to build. For your area you decide what comes next, based on what customers need and what matters for the company. You write down why, so the team can follow and give feedback. You ship early. The first version goes to a few customers as soon as it's useful. Then you improve it based on what they say and do. You build all of it. Data model, backend, frontend and UI. The result has to be clean, simple and intuitive to use, not only working. You do support for your area. When something breaks or a customer is stuck, you fix it and tell them it's fixed. You check whether it worked. Your job isn't done when the feature is live. You look at whether customers use it and whether it solved their problem. You automate what you can. When a customer asks a support question, you add the answer to our knowledge base and update our internal agent, so next time it's handled automatically. A lot already runs on its own here, bug fixes are already processed semi-automatically, and we keep automating more. Examples of what you could work on A customer wants to bring their old file storage into our document management, with their own folder structure and thousands of documents, and it should be fast and AI-supported. You look at how they've organized their files, build the import as a general feature for all customers, set it up for them and test it with their folder structure. Then you check whether the AI assigned every document to the right building, apartment or contact and fix what doesn't fit. A customer reports that the inbox agent gave a tenant a wrong answer. You look at what the agent did, fix the tool or its instructions and let the customer know. Only a few customers build their own agents in the sandbox. You find out why, by looking at the data and talking to customers, make the setup simpler and check whether more customers use it afterwards. Property managers do the same task fifty times a day and it takes too many clicks. You notice it, talk to them about how they work and make it faster. Our tech stack Everything is TypeScript, from the database schema to the frontend. Backend: Convex (database & serverless functions) Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui Agents: Vercel AI SDK, LiveKit for voice You'll build with Claude and get as many AI tokens as you need. jobs.description: About Us We are an established Independent Sales Organization with seven years of experience in the credit-card-processing and merchant-services industry. We are seeking an entrepreneurial data-science leader to design and lead this initiative from research and prototype development through prospective testing and commercialization. The Opportunity This is not a conventional data-science position in which a completed dataset and predefined model are handed to you. You will help determine what data matters, how it should be collected and labeled, and how qualitative sales intelligence can be transformed into quantitative predictions. Because our historical labeled data is limited, the initial work will include analyzing current sales-call recordings, interviewing members of our sales organization and identifying the characteristics, circumstances and behaviors associated with merchants who are receptive to switching processors. The successful candidate will build an initial lead-scoring methodology, test it against real-world sales results and continuously improve it as new outcome data is generated. This is a founding-level opportunity with salary and equity participation in the resulting platform. The right candidate will have substantial autonomy and the opportunity to create a potentially valuable commercial product within an established operating business. Responsibilities Develop the overall research, data and AI strategy for a proprietary merchant lead-intelligence platform. Analyze recorded sales conversations using transcription, natural-language processing, large language models and human-reviewed qualitative research. Create a structured framework for extracting relevant information from calls, including merchant characteristics, processing concerns, switching triggers, objections, urgency, decision-maker engagement and sales outcomes. Interview sales representatives and company leadership to capture domain knowledge that may not appear in existing structured data. Design reliable labeling and quality-control procedures for call transcripts and sales outcomes. Identify the signals most likely to predict meaningful sales progression, including statement submissions, follow-up meetings, proposals and signed merchant accounts. Develop an initial transparent, rules-based scoring model suitable for use while labeled data remains limited. Progressively develop statistical and machine-learning models as sufficient prospective data becomes available. Identify and evaluate external data sources that could reveal merchant size, growth, industry, number of locations, technology, ownership changes, hiring activity and other relevant characteristics. Connect internal conversation insights to externally observable business signals that can be used to identify new prospects. Design controlled sales experiments comparing AI-selected leads with leads selected through our existing process. Establish appropriate performance metrics, including conversion lift, precision among top-ranked leads, customer-acquisition cost and expected merchant profitability. Work with sales leadership to integrate lead recommendations into the company’s existing workflow. Build or manage the development of an initial working prototype and subsequent production platform.
